requirement.statement: The system MUST prove the ordinary-language workflow product through a real TUI local-runtime multi-turn journey before claiming the human experience complete.

case.given: A person asks in ordinary language for a reusable workflow that reads an AI hot-topic portal and produces a trend report
case.when: The person separately confirms publication and later confirms execution through TUI conversation
case.then: The system MUST preserve a proven draft before publication, MUST publish without execution after the first confirmation, and MUST access the network and return a grounded report only after the second confirmation

case.given: The TUI journey is under automated acceptance
case.when: The test submits and observes the conversation
case.then: The test MUST use TuiRuntimeClient local-runtime, WorkflowFulfill, native authoring/runtime tools, persisted workflow facts and Eidolon effect execution rather than component-only calls or prompt-string assertions
